adapter_policy.disagreement: diagnostic, not automatic exclusion unless preregistered before launch
adapter_policy.primary: average task-level outcome across preregistered adapters

missing_or_non_scoreable_policy.replacement_policy_after_outcomes_known: no post-hoc replacement after terminal outcomes are known
missing_or_non_scoreable_policy.replacement_policy_before_launch: replace only before paid launch and rerun statement/source gates
missing_or_non_scoreable_policy.scoreability_failure_policy: 100% planned cells must complete or every missing cell must follow the preregistered non-scoreable handling rule.

primary_comparison.name: Barcarolle weighted predictor vs H_future observed pass rate

scoring_formulas.insufficient_evidence: label when scoreable support or interval half-width misses the preregistered gate
scoring_formulas.wilson_interval: Wilson score interval by preregistered repo/split or stratum

success_failure_insufficient_evidence.failure: Any primary stratum exceeds the 0.15 absolute gap threshold or any primary policy gate fails.
success_failure_insufficient_evidence.insufficient_evidence: Scoreable cells complete but precision half-width or sparse-stratum support misses the preregistered gate.
success_failure_insufficient_evidence.success: All primary strata meet the 0.15 absolute gap threshold and policy/scoreability gates are zero-failure.
